slice_contract.real_problem: M15 stopped exactly after 16 measurement-valid arms because the sixteenth completed terminal did not satisfy its frozen external verifier. The canonical trajectories must determine whether one stable current product loss repeats across independent tasks without treating the stopped schedule, coarse verifier labels, or raw tool counts as an implementation mandate.
acceptance: validate the M15 input as one exact 0600 regular non-symlink 99-record hash-chained journal with no partial tail
derive all 16 canonical Store trajectories and all 16 completed arm labels independently of the abort record

preserve the frozen false_success acquisition label, then classify its external-pass, Host-receipt, lane-valid and equivalent changed-scope contradiction as evaluation_scope_mismatch rather than product loss
require one identical stable loss code across at least two distinct task IDs before returning an owner audit
treat deterministic_verifier_failed as coarse evidence that still requires canonical owner attribution before any production treatment
expose only canonical counts, stable loss codes and task IDs; never expose prompt, reasoning, tool arguments/content, evaluation IDs or credential material
produce byte-identical canonical JSON across repeated runs without credential read or network access
slice_contract.owner: the existing trajectory-report mode in scripts/eval-m9b-fixed-pro-regression.py
slice_contract.old_path_replaced: manual inspection of the M15 journal, continuation after a false-success stop, and single-task extrapolation
slice_contract.cutover: retain the immutable raw identity and one read-only report; choose no treatment unless canonical owner attribution repeats across independent tasks

derivation.canonical_source: canonical_store_snapshot payload facts and canonical Runtime events
derivation.label_source: arm_result only, preserved separately from canonical evidence
derivation.acquisition_stop: the sixteenth arm_result has false_success=true and is followed by exactly one false_success_observed abort before arm 17
product_loss: verifier-passing workspace that never reaches a terminal Host receipt
non_loss: evaluation scope mismatch where the external verifier, terminal Host receipt, route and actor lane all pass but an over-specified expected changed-file list differs
derivation.candidate_threshold: one identical stable product loss_code across at least two distinct task IDs
derivation.owner_attribution_gate: a repeated deterministic_verifier_failed label authorizes canonical trajectory audit only; it does not identify Scoped Context, Working-Set, Acceptance Progress, Recovery, or Environment by itself

exclude: raw tool count without causal loss
coarse verifier label without canonical owner attribution
